title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Given a string s containing just the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is valid: every open bracket must be closed by the same type of bracket, in the correct order. The empty string is valid.
hints: Push opening brackets onto a stack.
When you see a closing bracket, pop and check it matches the expected opener.
The string is valid only if the stack is empty at the end.
